name: i.safe MOBILE IS540.2
summary: The i.safe MOBILE IS540.2 is an intrinsically safe (Ex ic) smartphone from i.safe MOBILE, certified for Zone 2/22 under ATEX and IECEx. It runs Android 14, with 5G and a user-replaceable battery.

atex.marking: II 3G Ex ic IIC T4 Gc / II 3D Ex ic IIIC T135°C Dc

iecex.marking: Ex ic IIC T4 Gc / Ex ic IIIC T135°C Dc

certification.northAmerica: NEC500 Class I Div 2 (per Nokia DAC; certificate number not found)

safety.conditions: Use only i.safe-approved accessories; see IS540.2 manual

specs.keys: Programmable red key (e.g. LWP); programmable left side key (e.g. PTT)
